| Status | `503 Service Unavailable` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/database-busy` |

The database was too busy to take this request in time: another request, such as an import batch, held the write lock for longer than this one could wait for it, or every database connection stayed taken while it waited for one. Wait the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (repeated as `retry_after` in the body) and send the same request again.

Any route that reads or writes the database can answer this, so no route in the OpenAPI document lists it.
